specification.objective: Round only the indicated selected employee profile surfaces, preserving behavior and layout.

requirements.statement: Use radius 8 for profile icon, profile badges, overview icons and detail tabs; radius 12 for overview cards and registration panel.
Preserve existing behavior, colors, layout, semantics, interactions, selected states and internal divider; do not change shared pill callers outside the profile.
Widget regression covers each surface, both themes, tabs and interaction at desktop and mobile widths.
Store a byte-identical copy of the locked contract at the declared contract path.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Requested profile surfaces use the specified radii in both themes and responsive layouts.
Tab selection and edit interactions continue to function, and registration divider remains.
The committed-scope contract copy equals the locked bytes.

invariants.statement: Unrelated pill uses remain unchanged and no behavior, layout, colors or data are altered.

forbidden_states.statement: Requested profile surfaces retain square corners or unrelated components are rounded.

inputs.statement: Selected profile screenshot and existing employee detail widgets.

outputs.statement: Rounded selected profile surfaces and regression coverage.

failure_semantics.statement: Widget regression fails when any specified radius or interaction is incorrect.

argv: from pathlib import Path; import sys; a=Path('docs/contracts/admin-employee-profile-rounded-v1.polis.json'); print('contract_present' if a.is_file() else 'contract_missing'); sys.exit(0 if a.is_file() else 1)
